images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE coherent wide 16:10 game scene render for a landscape PDF about a single-player 30-second target-shooting prototype. Generate a new scene using the input ONLY as a style, character and camera reference.
Input image 1 role: style/camera/character reference. Keep the exact sunny low-poly garden visual language, cute plump yellow baby dragon with orange back spikes and blue scarf, simple blue toy bubble blaster, cream walls, faceted green shrubs with small cream flowers, blue sky, soft readable shadows.
Primary request: redesign the reference into a compact SINGLE PLAYER TARGET RANGE. ONE small yellow dragon is near the lower center seen from behind, only about 12 percent of the image height, same distant third-person follow perspective, enough ground visible. No other characters, no enemies. The open lawn is flat and navigable with no internal barriers; low boundary wall and decorative wooden crate on extreme left, shrubs only outside the open shooting lane. A short low cream platform/ramp may be visible OUTSIDE the far-right boundary as background only.
Targets: exactly SIX simple wooden target stands arranged across the far half of the lawn in a shallow arc, with clear separation and all visible from the character. The stands occupy screen positions roughly x20%/y55%, x30%/y44%, x44%/y40%, x58%/y40%, x72%/y44%, x83%/y55%. Three stands (first, third, fifth) hold upright bright red-and-cream bullseye disks, the other three have no disk and show just their empty small wooden supports. Bullseyes are clean circular toy targets facing the player, no people silhouettes, no text. Keep middle ground uncluttered.
Composition: believable simple browser Three.js prototype art, perspective with sky horizon at upper third, not overhead isometric. Player feels small, terrain feels spacious, no cinematic close-up. Upper 16% and lower 12% remain visually calm for later native PDF HUD overlays.
Text: absolutely NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO UI, NO crosshair, NO HUD, NO border, NO watermark. The PDF will add all readable UI itself.
Avoid: giant character, realistic violence, multiplayer, complex weapons, photoreal textures, volumetric cinematic fog, impossible lighting, tiny far-away unreadable targets.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: gameplay action scene for the same single-player 30-second shooting PDF.
Input image 1 is the exact edit target. Preserve its camera, framing, garden geometry, sky, shrubs, cream walls, wooden crate, six target stand positions and the small yellow dragon/blue scarf identity and scale. Change only this action: the dragon is aiming the blue bubble blaster at the THIRD target stand from the left (the central red target around 44% image x, 40% y). Show a readable diagonal stream of two or three SMALL cyan spherical bubbles travelling FROM the gun barrel near the player's right shoulder TOWARD that target, correctly foreshortened along this line. At the target show a modest cyan impact ring, a few tiny gold star flecks, and the bullseye disk just beginning to tip backwards on impact. The first and fifth target disks remain intact; second/fourth/sixth stands remain empty. No huge explosion. Keep the character small at lower center, full body visible, mostly rear view, and no other characters.
Only cosmetic animation moment, plausible stylized low-poly browser Three.js graphics. Bright and clean, not cinematic. No text, no letters, no numbers, no crosshair, no score, no HUD, no menus, no border, no watermark. Preserve all other scene details.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: OPTIONAL FUTURE idea image, clearly a separate camera angle in the same single-player garden world.
Input image 1 is a style, character and environment reference, not an exact camera lock.
Imagine one future experiment: a small cute yellow baby dragon with orange back spikes and a BLUE scarf has just jumped from a low cream garden platform on the RIGHT edge into the lawn. Capture the dragon in midair, aiming its same blue toy bubble blaster DOWNWARD toward a red-and-cream circular target on a wooden stand below, sending a short cyan bubble trail toward that target. Full body and separated feet clearly visible, a soft landing shadow directly below on the lawn. No other characters. No enemies. Other targets remain on the lawn in the background.
Keep same sunny low-poly garden: cream boundary walls, open green grass, a small wooden crate by a side, faceted round green shrubs with little cream flowers, blue sky. Camera pulled back in a believable third-person FOLLOW view, not isometric map, character occupies at most 15 percent of image height and the low platform/drop is clearly visible without making it a tall cliff. One simple sloped access ramp at the right outside the main shooting lane. The platform is less than one character-height high, easy to imagine making in Three.js, not an elaborate level.
Wide 16:10 composition, calm upper area for native PDF annotation. No text, no letters, no numbers, NO UI, NO HUD, no health bar, no score, no timer, no watermark, no gun realism. The goal is a small optional jumping experiment rather than a more complex multiplayer game.

Use case: text-localization / precise-object-edit. Asset type: main menu concept for a SINGLE-PLAYER game PDF.
Input image 1 is the EXACT screenshot edit target. Preserve the entire left 2/3 illustration, cute yellow round dragon BLUE scarf and blue bubble gun, cyan bubbles, red circular target, low-poly grass, shrubs, cream walls, crate, warm lighting, camera, proportions and original overall split layout. Preserve the warm cream right panel and teal rounded-button visual style.
Change the RIGHT menu panel only, carefully typeset accurate simplified Chinese:
1. Small text at upper right: "登录 / 注册".
2. Large playful title is now EXACTLY "奶龙小靶场" (replace 竞技场 with 小靶场). Keep yellow 奶龙 and white remaining characters with dark teal outline, modest size to fit.
3. Directly below the title add the subtitle EXACTLY "30 秒，你能打中几个？" in legible dark teal medium text.
4. REMOVE the nickname field and user icon entirely. No "奶糖" input.
5. Primary dark teal large button text EXACTLY "开始挑战".
6. Secondary outlined pale green button text EXACTLY "我的成绩".
7. Bottom small pill with gear remains with text EXACTLY "设置".
Use generous clear spacing. No friend play, no multiplayer, no room, no nickname form. First screen should invite play and not present a login form; login is a small optional link until Start is clicked.
Do not change the left illustration or add other characters. Do not draw browser chrome or watermark. One clean wide screenshot, same aspect ratio as input.

ui: HUD, dialog and results composed as native ReportLab PDF graphics. Source raster files unmodified.
